method: Fifty new natural-language questions created for a paired Ask AI 1 and Ask AI 2 full-text relevance evaluation. Anchor topics document coverage only and are not supplied to either retrieval method.

What was Sheol, and did ancient Israelites think people remained conscious there after death?
